what: Why Itemator is written in Python: the language study of 2026-10-11. Scores and day estimates are estimates by research agents, not measurements; the speed figures are in timing_rules.json and the GitLab figures were read from GitLab's API on 2026-10-11.

rust.main_reason: no gain over a sub-millisecond Python run; heavy builds; image 327 MB against 43 MB

cpp.main_reason: no mature MIT library for reading diffs

go.main_reason: a good language but no gain for this workload

typescript.main_reason: no gain in bug-catching over typed Python; the Duo agent environment blocks the npm registry

gitlab_default_flow_image_runtimes: Python, Go, Ruby, Node and Java; no Rust or C/C++ compiler (Dockerfile of gitlab-org/duo-workflow/default-docker-image, read 2026-10-11)
